subtitulo: Before the key and after the failed checkpoint
introPt: A traveller improves the room before assignment, then reports one defect and escalates only after the promised repair checkpoint fails.
cenario: The quiet room is assigned; the air conditioner later needs a timed repair and a room change.

dialogo.es: Sí, tengo una lejos del elevador.
dialogo.pt: Yes, I have one far from the elevator.
The air conditioning does not work.
What time can they check it?

dialogo.es: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
dialogo.pt: It still doesn't work. I need another room, please.

perguntas.pergunta: When was the quieter room requested?
perguntas.explica: The lesson opens with improvements before the key is issued.

perguntas.pergunta: Did the dialogue promise late checkout at every hotel?
opcoes: No; it is an availability and policy question
perguntas.explica: The hotel answers its current limit and charge; the course does not universalise it.

perguntas.pergunta: What made the defect report useful?
opcoes: It named the object and observable failure
It included a long travel story
perguntas.explica: The air conditioner and failure can be inspected immediately.
A time turns an open promise into a moment the traveller can verify.

perguntas.pergunta: When did the traveller ask for another room?
opcoes: After the checkpoint passed and the defect remained
perguntas.explica: Escalation follows the failed repair, not the opening move.
